PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0.3 — GPS navigation with edge resizing and responsive HUD text.
PluginData.Description: GPS navigation, searchable destination picker, SDX main-drive catalog, speed control, flip-and-burn guidance and precision attitude controls. Resize the navigation HUD from its edges and corners; text follows panel height. Preserves flight settings and automatic overlay shutdown. Windows / Pulsar Legacy.
